gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-bpmf-huninn: Bruno Ace draws every letter with a ruler-straight line and lets its counters stay open to the outside. Bpmf Huninn, a plain sans, is the softer voice, with wide channels into each bowl.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: A line as constant as a plotter pen's gives Bruno Ace its unmistakable look up top. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std is the opposite temperament, a sans with a restrained swell in its curves that feels approachable.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-cairo: Bruno Ace has round letters whose rims match the stems, giving a measured, lingering rhythm, one character per beat. And Cairo, a plain sans with wide channels into every bowl, keeps a long stretch of text moving smoothly.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-cambay: Cambay is a plain sans whose rounds gap open like a cracked bangle, a modern touch beneath Bruno Ace. Text in it moves along without snagging.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-cantarell: Cantarell reads friendly and unfussy, its c shapes pulling their tips well apart. Bump up its size a notch if you want it to hold its own under Bruno Ace, whose ruler-drawn lines and lingering rhythm already stand out.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-catamaran: Catamaran, a plain sans, feels loose and curvy, almost unclamped. Bruno Ace, drawn with no calligraphic swelling anywhere, holds the top of the page in rigid lines while Catamaran relaxes below.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Expressive is the right word for Bruno Ace, whose counters stay connected to the outside and whose n arches match their stems. And Chiron Hei HK, a modern sans-serif with a bracelet-wide c, gives it a polished partner.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-commissioner: Distinctive and a bit futuristic, Bruno Ace lingers on each character in a constant-width line. But Commissioner, a sans with a smooth read and no clogged curves, settles things down beside it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-didact-gothic: Bruno Ace brings a ruler-drawn line and a lingering rhythm, one character per beat, to the heading. And Didact Gothic, a sans whose bowls never close up and snag, carries the text with a modern ease.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-dotgothic16: Ruler-drawn lines and counters open to the outside make Bruno Ace unmistakable at the top. DotGothic16, a sans with a tube-like thickness through every bend, is the approachable partner that completes it.
